ng-add.description: Adds @koobiq/components library to the project and installs dependencies

new-icons-pack.description: Updates prefixes and names of changed/removed icons

css-selectors.description: Updates prefixes and names of changed/removed icons

deprecated-icons.description: Updates prefixes and names of changed/removed icons

empty-state-size-attr.description: Updates attr name and value in ts and html

loader-overlay-size-attr.description: Updates attr name and value in ts and html

autocomplete-panel-width-auto.description: Replaces kbq-autocomplete panelWidth="auto" with panelWidth="fit-content" in ts and html

icons-replacement.description: Updates names of icons in dedicated files

v20-upgrade.description: Migrates deprecated API removed in @koobiq/components v20.0.0

filter-bar-signals.description: Migrates KbqFilterBar consumers to the signal-based API (filter/pipeTemplates/isChanged/... reads become calls)

alert-signals.description: Migrates KbqAlert consumers to the signal-based API (compact/alertStyle reads become calls; warns on alertColor value change, now-protected members, narrowed inputs)

dropdown-demote-overlay.description: Removes the demoteOverlay input, the KBQ_DROPDOWN_HOST provider and dead .cdk-overlay-container_dropdown styles left by the overlay demotion removal

app-switcher-signals.description: Migrates KbqAppSwitcherTrigger consumers to its model()-based API (selectedApp reads become calls, writes become .set()) and warns on selectedSite value semantics, the removed header/footer/isTrapFocus/getIcon members and the new inline-icon sanitization

button-state-and-styles.description: Rewrites the removed physical border-radius mixins to logical ones and warns about the v21.0.0 button host-attribute, button-group ownership, .kbq-progress and locale changes

form-field-signals.description: Migrates KbqFormField and KbqHint consumers to the signal-based API (content-query and has* reads become calls, KbqPasswordHint.regex writes become .set()), moves [attr.aria-label] on kbq-cleaner to the [aria-label] input, and warns on the lost QueryList API, the removed mixinColor and the new required a11y locale keys

button-truncation.description: Moves edge icons of a button/button-toggle into the kbqButtonPrefix/kbqButtonSuffix slots so labels keep their ellipsis, and reports stylesheet overrides affected by the new truncation layout

tag-slots.description: Marks legacy implicit kbq-icon content in tags with kbqTagPrefix so tags can use explicit content slots

button-supported-colors.description: Removes button colors outside theme/theme-fade/contrast/contrast-fade from templates and warns about the ones it cannot resolve, plus the transparent default color change

mandatory-peer-dependencies.description: Adds @angular/animations, overlayscrollbars and @koobiq/date-adapter, which became mandatory peers of @koobiq/components, to projects whose package manager does not install new peers on upgrade

button-toggle-signals-and-aria.description: Migrates KbqButtonToggleGroup consumers to its signal inputs (vertical/multiple reads become calls) and reports the ARIA, tab-order and keyboard changes of the button-toggle review, including icon-only toggles left without an accessible name

scrollbar-deprecated-path.description: Rewrites @koobiq/components/scrollbar imports to @koobiq/components/scrollbar/deprecated — the overlayscrollbars-based implementation moved there when the dependency-free implementation was promoted to @koobiq/components/scrollbar

filter-bar-rename-action.description: Removes the `name` key from filter-bar locale configurations and reports the rename rework: renaming a filter no longer marks it saved, so it stops persisting the pending pipe edits

navbar-signals-and-aria.description: Migrates navbar consumers to the signal-based API (expanded/configuration/isCollapsed/collapsable reads become calls, expanded/tabIndex writes become .set(), rectangle-element horizontal/vertical become orientation) and reports the removed tooltip inheritance, the removed disabled/hovered members and the new ARIA, keyboard and z-index behaviour

locale-configuration-providers.description: Rewrites { provide: KBQ_<X>_CONFIGURATION, useValue: … } provider entries of the navbar, notification-center, app-switcher, search-expandable, datepicker and filter-bar to the kbq<X>LocaleConfigurationProvider() helpers, which is what still overrides the locale now that those tokens carry the defaults only, and warns on the provider shapes it cannot rewrite plus the removed externalConfiguration and read-only configuration members

list-tree-multiple-input.description: Rewrites the reworked multiple input of kbq-list-selection and kbq-tree-selection in ts and html

title-encapsulation.description: Reports the members of KbqTitleDirective that stopped being public in the title review — the removed resizeStream Subject (the directive now injects the CDK SharedResizeObserver and re-measures container resizes on its own, so a manual push has no counterpart), the now-private hasOnlyText, the removed ngOnDestroy declaration that a subclass calling super.ngOnDestroy() depended on, and the child/parent/isHorizontalOverflown/isVerticalOverflown/handleElementEnter/hideTooltip measurement members that became protected. Warn-only: each member is gone or hidden outright, so there is no expression to rewrite a call site to.

file-upload-deprecated-outputs.description: Renames the deprecated KbqMultipleFileUploadComponent.fileQueueChanged / KbqSingleFileUploadComponent.fileQueueChange outputs to filesChange / fileChange

split-button-optional-disabled.description: Reports the KbqSplitButton members whose type changed in the split-button review. disabled reports boolean | undefined instead of boolean: the backing field has no initializer, so a control with no [disabled] binding always returned undefined behind a non-nullable type, and the call sites that assigned it to a boolean or compared it against false were quietly wrong. The protected buttons content query moved from QueryList<KbqButton> to a signal query, so a subclass reading buttons.changes or buttons.length has to read buttons() instead. Warn-only: narrowing boolean | undefined back to boolean is a decision the call site owns. Notes the silent part too — an empty <kbq-split-button> no longer throws outside dev mode.

actions-panel-overlay-container.description: Reports the call sites affected by KbqActionsPanelConfig.overlayContainer becoming the element the panel is rendered into rather than an anchor for its positioning. Warns — without auto-fixing — that such a panel is now clipped by an `overflow: hidden` element and scrolls away inside one that scrolls its own content, that the element gains a child node and a `position: relative` promotion while the panel is open, and that `maxWidth` is no longer ignored when `overlayContainer` is set. Also notes that a panel opened with the option bypasses a globally provided OverlayContainer.

popover-leave-delay.description: Reports the popover call sites whose meaning changed in the popover review. A dead this.leaveDelay ?? 500 — the base initialises the field to 0, and 0 ?? 500 is 0 — made hover mode close the panel before the pointer could cross the gap to it. The delay is derived from the trigger now, and kbqLeaveDelay is a write-only input that records having been bound, so a programmatic leaveDelay assignment no longer sticks: the next write to trigger overwrites it. Also reports the now-readonly onConfirm and placementChange emitting KbqPopUpPlacementValues instead of string. Warn-only. Notes the parts with no call site: the confirm popover takes its defaults from the locale instead of hardcoded Russian, the untorn-down global ScrollDispatcher subscription is bounded, and the trigger can be imported standalone.

accordion-state-saving-default.description: Reports the consequences of KbqAccordion.useStateSaving defaulting to true. An accordion nobody configured now remembers which sections the user left open, so the migration reports the absence of the input rather than its presence: defaultValue applies to the first visit only, the storage key is derived from where the accordion sits in the document when no stateSavingKey is given, and an item with no value persists its position instead of the id it used to report. Warn-only: the markup whose behaviour changed is exactly the markup that says nothing about the input, and rewriting it to opt out would withhold the feature the release is shipping. Notes the storage format too — entries move under a kbq.state. prefix and carry a timestamp so a key stranded by a markup change is collected once it outlives KBQ_STATE_SAVING_TTL, while a 20.2.0 entry under the bare key is still read but never rewritten or removed. Also reports the inputs moving onto the KbqStateSaving host directive: the markup is unchanged, but useStateSaving and stateSavingKey are no longer members of KbqAccordion, so reading them off the component no longer compiles.

tree-state-saving-default.description: Reports the consequences of the tree persisting its expanded nodes, with useStateSaving defaulting to true. A tree nobody configured now remembers which branches the user left open, so the migration reports the absence of the input rather than its presence. It also reports the tree control that decides how a node is identified: expansion is persisted by the value FlatTreeControl.getValue returns, which must be a string that is stable across reloads and unique within the tree, because a node object is re-created whenever the data is replaced. Expansion the application performs itself — expandAll, collapseAll, direct writes to expansionModel — is not persisted until saveState is called, and a tree on a NestedTreeControl persists nothing at all because that control has no getValue. Selection is never persisted; it stays with the form control the tree is bound to. Warn-only: the markup whose behaviour changed is exactly the markup that says nothing about the input, and rewriting it to opt out would withhold the feature the release is shipping.

state-saving-default.description: Reports the consequences of KbqTabGroup, KbqSidebar and KbqContentPanelContainer persisting the state a user changes, with useStateSaving defaulting to true on all three. A tab group remembers the selected tab (by tabId and by position), a sidebar remembers whether it was open and the width it was last closed at, and a content panel remembers whether it was open and the width it was dragged to. Each of them keeps out of the store while the application drives that state — a bound selectedIndex or activeTab on the group, a bound opened on the sidebar and on the panel — so the migration reports the absence of those bindings rather than their presence. It also reports tabs left without a tabId, where the selection falls back to a position that survives a reload but not a reordering, and reads of KbqContentPanelContainer.opened, which is openedInput now and reads undefined while nothing binds it. kbq-tab-nav-bar deliberately never persists: the router owns which link is active there. Warn-only: the markup whose behaviour changed is exactly the markup that says nothing about the input, and rewriting it to opt out would withhold the feature the release is shipping.

filter-bar-state-saving-default.description: Reports the consequences of KbqFilterBar remembering which filter is selected and the edits made to it, with useStateSaving defaulting to true. A bar nobody configured now restores the filter the user left, so the migration reports the absence of the input rather than its presence. Unlike the components that shipped before it, the bar restores over the value a [filter] binding supplied at initialization: filter is a model(), so the restore writes through it, filterChange fires, and the application loads data for the restored filter exactly as it would for one the user had picked — only a later change wins. A filter is identified by its name, the only identity KbqFilter has, so renaming a saved filter loses what was stored for it and a name no longer in the filters list restores nothing; a list loaded from a server is waited for. What is stored is the name, the changed flag, and one entry per pipe — its id (or name) and its value — because a pipe built from a template keeps that template compareWith and date bounds, which do not survive being written to storage, so the rest of each pipe is rebuilt from filters and pipeTemplates while restoring. saveFilterState()/restoreFilterState() are unchanged and unrelated: they snapshot the filter in memory within one session. Warn-only: the markup whose behaviour changed is exactly the markup that says nothing about the input, and rewriting it to opt out would withhold the feature the release is shipping.

tooltip-pointer-events-and-types.description: Reports the tooltip review changes a consumer has to act on. The headline is silent: ignoreTooltipPointerEvents defaults to false instead of true, so every pane is hoverable (WCAG 1.4.13) and also captures clicks meant for whatever it floats over — markup that never mentioned the input compiles unchanged and behaves differently, so the migration reports the absence of the input rather than its presence. Also reports the removed KbqPopUpTrigger.scheduler, the delay argument getMouseLeaveListener() no longer takes, placementChange emitting KbqPopUpPlacementValues instead of string, and the any that left content/header/context/modifier. Warn-only: the markup whose behaviour changed is the markup that says nothing about the input, and a narrowed type is fixed by giving the call site the right type.

toast-stack-and-defaults.description: Reports the breaking parts of the toast review — the members KbqToastComponent lost when it moved from KbqToastService to the KBQ_TOAST_STACK token, the narrowed animation subject and showTemplate context — and notes that the data passed to show() is no longer written to, so its style and icon defaults are resolved inside the toast

select-signal-inputs.description: Reports the KbqSelect members that became signal inputs or stopped being public in the select review: hiddenItemsText (accessor pair to InputSignal<string | undefined>, so a write has to become the binding and a read a call), hiddenItemsTextFormatter (an overridable method to an input holding the function), the now-protected overlayDir and triggerRect, the Event instead of any on onRemoveMatcherItem, and the removed selectEvents constant together with the core/select/events module it lived in. Every input kept its alias, so no template needs migrating. Warn-only. Notes the parts with no call site: multiple mode orders the selection by the panel instead of by a default comparator that subtracted the values and never produced that order, the untorn-down locale subscription that retained every destroyed select is gone, and the select carries combobox/listbox/option ARIA.

tree-select-signals.description: Reports the KbqTreeSelect members that became signal-backed, protected or disappeared in the tree-select review: the removed valueChange output (declared as the other half of a two-way binding on a value input that does not exist, and never emitted, so a (valueChange) binding never fired), the removed getPanelClasses/getPanelTheme/isRtl/transformOrigin template helpers, hiddenItemsText and hiddenItemsTextFormatter as signal inputs, hiddenItems as a WritableSignal and colorForState as a computed, and the options/tags/overlayDir/triggerRect/panelDoneAnimatingStream/changeDetectorRef plumbing that became protected. Warn-only. Notes the parts with no call site: KbqTreeSelectChange is generic with a typed value, the embedded tree is initialised through KbqTreeSelection.initializeForEmbedding() instead of a second manual ngAfterContentInit() that left duplicate subscriptions on the search-filtering hot path, the dead { provide: KbqTree, useExisting: KbqTreeSelect } provider is gone, and the component renders a host id so the form field label no longer dangles.

tree-signals.description: Reports the six members of the tree that became read-only — KbqTreeNodeToggle.disabled, KbqTreeBase.nodeDefs, KbqTreeNodePadding.indent/indentUnits, KbqTreeNodeToggleBaseDirective.recursive and KbqTreeOption.onFocus/onBlur — with the call sites that write or read them; assigning any of them now throws

read-state-dwell-handlers.description: Renames the KbqReadStateDirective dwell handlers (mouseenterHandler → startDwell, mouseleaveHandler → endDwell) on receivers typed as the directive, and reports the read-only timestamp getter plus the keyboard dwell channel the directive now tracks alongside the pointer one

notification-center-signals.description: Reports the notification-center API changes: the removed KBQ_NOTIFICATION_CENTER_SCROLL_STRATEGY_FACTORY_PROVIDER, .emit() on the onReload/onNextPage/onDelete Subjects, imperative access to the trigger inputs that became signals, and the now payload-free changes stream

autocomplete-signals.description: Migrates KbqAutocomplete and KbqAutocompleteTrigger consumers to the finished signal-based API. Rewrites programmatic reads of displayWith, autoActiveFirstOption, openOnFocus, showPanel and isOpen on receivers typed KbqAutocomplete, and of autocompleteDisabled on receivers typed KbqAutocompleteTrigger, including reads via template reference variables on <kbq-autocomplete> (external and inline templates). Warns on classList, which was a write-only accumulator behind the class input and is an internal computed now, on writes to isOpen, which is a read-only computed over the new attached signal, and on view/content queries that return the instance. Rewrites a showPanel write to .set(), and a displayWith invocation to displayWith()(value), since displayWith is the one member whose value is itself a function. Reports the booleanAttribute transforms, of which only openOnFocus actually changes behaviour, the fact that binding autoActiveFirstOption overrides KBQ_AUTOCOMPLETE_DEFAULT_OPTIONS as it did before, and the panel id shape, which the CDK _IdGenerator leaves unchanged under the default APP_ID.

badge-signals.description: Migrates KbqBadge consumers to its finished signal-based API. Rewrites value-safe programmatic reads of the now-signal members (compact, outline) to calls on receivers typed KbqBadge, including reads via template reference variables on <kbq-badge> (external and inline templates). Warns - without auto-fixing - on badgeColor (now a read-only InputSignal that reports the raw color instead of the kbq-badge_<color> class), on iconItem which became protected, and on the KbqBadgeCssStyler members that became private (icons, isIconButton, nativeElement, updateClassModifierForIcons). Reports the compact/outline booleanAttribute behavior change, which has no call site to point at.

markdown-signals.description: Migrates KbqMarkdown consumers to its finished signal-based API. markdownText was the last accessor input in the package - its setter did the rendering, which is why the automated signal migration skipped it. Rewrites programmatic reads of markdownText to calls on receivers typed KbqMarkdown and on the inject()/viewChild() forms, including reads via template reference variables on <kbq-markdown> (external and inline templates). Warns on a subclass write to resultHtml, which was already protected and is a read-only computed now, and on signal queries, which hold the instance behind a call of their own. Reports the two behavior fixes the review made: clearing markdownText now clears the output instead of leaving the last render on screen, and a component that both projects content and binds the input falls back to the projected content once the input goes empty.

progress-spinner-signals.description: Migrates KbqProgressSpinner consumers to its finished signal-based API. size was the last accessor input on the spinner - its setter also computed the SVG circle radius, which is why the automated signal migration skipped it. Rewrites programmatic reads of size, id, value and mode to calls on receivers typed KbqProgressSpinner and on the inject()/viewChild() forms, including reads via template reference variables on <kbq-progress-spinner> (external and inline templates). id, value and mode became signal inputs in 20.0.0 and no migration has covered them until now. Warns on the derived members that became protected (svgCircleRadius, percentage, dashOffsetPercent) and on view/content queries that return the instance. Reports the two changes with no call site to point at: size is typed ProgressSpinnerSize instead of an arbitrary string, and value is a numberAttribute input.

loader-overlay-signals.description: Migrates KbqLoaderOverlay consumers to its finished signal-based API. text and caption were the inputs the automated signal migration skipped, because they are read inside @if blocks. Rewrites programmatic reads of both to calls on receivers typed KbqLoaderOverlay and on the inject()/viewChild() forms, including reads via template reference variables on <kbq-loader-overlay> (external and inline templates). Warns on the template helpers that became protected (isExternalIndicator, isExternalText, isExternalCaption, isEmpty, spinnerSize), on the content queries that became private (externalIndicator, externalText, externalCaption), on programmatic writes, which no longer compile, and on reads through a signal query, which need two calls. Reports every file carrying a valueless transparent attribute, the one change with no compile error behind it. Reports that text and caption now report string | undefined, and that transparent is a booleanAttribute input, so a valueless attribute means true where it used to render the filled background.

checkbox-signals.description: Migrates KbqCheckbox consumers to its finished signal-based API. Rewrites programmatic reads of the now-signal one-way inputs (id, clickAction, big, required, value, name, labelPosition) to calls on receivers typed KbqCheckbox, including reads via template reference variables on <kbq-checkbox> (external and inline templates). Warns on programmatic writes, on the template plumbing that became protected (inputId, inputElement, getAriaChecked, onInputClick, onInteractionEvent, onLabelTextChange) whether it is read from TypeScript or through a template reference, and on reads through a signal query, which need two calls. Reports the 0-based counter the CDK _IdGenerator brings - the id shape itself is unchanged for a default APP_ID - the [id]=null fallback on the host, the booleanAttribute transforms on checked/big/indeterminate, which coerce a bound 0 or empty string to true as well, the required default, and value reporting string | undefined. checked, disabled, indeterminate and tabIndex stay accessor inputs over the KbqCheckable signals and are not touched.

link-signals.description: Migrates KbqLink consumers to its finished signal-based API. The three inputs the automated signal migration skipped were all accessors that did more than store a value. Rewrites programmatic reads of disabled to calls on receivers typed KbqLink, resolving the receiver per scope so a shadowing binding of another type is left alone. Warns - without auto-fixing - on tabIndex, which is now a read-only InputSignal reporting what was bound instead of folding in the disabled state, on programmatic writes of every shape (=, ||=, ++), which no longer compile, on the icon and print bookkeeping that left the public surface (hasIcon, printMode and printUrl are protected, icons and nativeElement are private, and icon, destroyRef and ngAfterContentInit are gone), and on reads through a signal query, which need two calls. Reports next to every rewritten file that disabled() is the bound input while disabledSignal() is the effective state kbqTooltip writes through forDisabledComponent. Reports that [print]="undefined" no longer marks the link as printable - an unbound link behaves exactly as before - and that a disabled link carries aria-disabled instead of the disabled attribute, which is not valid HTML on an anchor.

code-block-signals.description: Migrates KbqCodeBlock consumers to its finished signal-based API: nothing on the component is a decorator input any more. Rewrites reads of softWrap, viewAll, canDownload, files, activeFileIndex and hideTabs to calls on receivers typed KbqCodeBlock, including reads through template reference variables on <kbq-code-block> (external and inline templates), and rewrites a plain write of any of them to .set(...) - all six are WritableSignals over a backing input, because ModelOptions carries no transform and every one of them needs booleanAttribute or numberAttribute to keep a valueless attribute working. Warns - without auto-fixing - on compound assignments and increments, which would need the receiver spelled twice, on the backing inputs and the deprecated canLoad and codeFiles aliases, which can no longer be written, and on reads through a signal query, which need two calls. Reports that maxHeight now reports number | undefined and never NaN, that KbqCodeBlockHighlight.file is a readable required input instead of a write-only setter, that hideTabs reports what was bound while tabsHidden() is what the header does, that canLoad and codeFiles now fill in for canDownload and files rather than writing into them, and that an out-of-range activeFileIndex renders the first file while an empty files renders no code instead of throwing.

inline-edit-a11y-and-types.description: Migrates KbqInlineEdit consumers to the finished component. `mode` is a model() now — public, writable and two-way bindable via [(mode)] — so the `modeAsReadonly` alias that only exposed the hidden signal for reading was removed; reads of it are rewritten to `mode` in .ts and .html, with an index read or a destructuring reported instead. The `modeChange` output is generated by the model under the same name and type, so template bindings are unaffected, but it is no longer a class member and emits synchronously on the write — a programmatic subscription goes through toObservable(inlineEdit.mode). The rest is warn-only. The edit overlay's two `aria-hidden="true" tabindex="0"` sentinels are gone together with the KbqFocusRegionItem directive that marked them — an axe aria-hidden-focus failure and two dead-end tab stops — and the Tab boundary is resolved against the panel's own first and last tabbable control. role="button", aria-expanded, aria-disabled and the accessible name moved off the host onto .kbq-inline-edit__view-content (and onto .kbq-inline-edit__focus-anchor while the view content is interactive), so a selector that matched the host by tabindex or :focus has to be retargeted; the focus ring still lands on the host through cdk-keyboard-focused. setValueHandler takes (value: unknown) => void and validationTooltip a TemplateRef<unknown>, and KbqA11yLocaleConfiguration gained a required `edit` key. Notes the parts with no call site: saved/canceled are public, save() marks the controls touched itself and gates on the control validity rather than on the ErrorStateMatcher verdict (so typing no longer flips a pristine required field into its error look and commit() no longer writes a never-touched invalid value through), the panel finally reads --kbq-inline-edit-panel-shadow, and the private .kbq-mask* classes were renamed to .kbq-inline-edit__menu-mask*.
